children.name: Stegnosperma cubense A.Rich.
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico to C. America, Caribbean. It is a scrambling shrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Stegnosperma halimifolium Benth.
children.description: The native range of this species is W. & C. Mexico. It is a scrambling shrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Stegnosperma sanchezii Medrano & R.Medina
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (Puebla, Oaxaca). It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Stegnosperma watsonii D.J.Rogers
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (Sonora, Sinaloa). It is a scrambling shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.
